description: Find interactive classroom tools in Birkan Yavuz's catalog of 24 K-9 activities. Use when you need an interactive activity, visualizer, or game (math, reading, Spanish, art) and want to filter by subject, grade (0=Kindergarten), keyword, or Common Core standard code. Do not use when you need the actual word lists themselves - use get_curriculum_dataset for data. Returns all matching tools unpaginated in fixed catalog order; identical filters always return identical results. Requires no authentication.

query.description: Free-text match against tool names and objectives

standard_code.description: Optional curriculum standard code filter, full or short form (for example CCSS.Math.Content.1.OA.C.6 or 1.OA.C.6, RF.1.3)

subject.description: Subject filter; omit or 'all' for every subject

name: search_classroom_tools

invocation_id.description: Unique receipt id for this call; cite it to prove the data came from this server

results.description: Matching classroom tools, each with tool_id, record_digest, standard_codes, grade and objective

title: Search K-12 Interactive Educational Tools
